reason: The proposed action attempts to remove items by passing an empty new_item_ids array, but the policy specifies that pending-order item modification means changing items 'to an available new item of the same product but of different product option' — describing item replacement, not removal. The tool schema reinforces this by requiring new_item_ids entries to 'match the item id in the same position and be of the same product.' With new_item_ids empty, the call violates the policy's definition of how modify_items works. The policy provides no mechanism for partial item removal from pending orders; the only defined action that changes order contents for pending orders is item replacement via modify, not deletion.
policy_references: For a pending order, each item can be modified to an available new item of the same product but of different product option.
Modify items — tool schema: Each new item id should match the item id in the same position and be of the same product.
Generic action rules: Exchange or modify order tools can only be called once per order.
